evals.prompt: Implement a small pill-shaped control from a Figma file as adaptive HTML/CSS, then compare a Figma 4x export with a Chromium 4x screenshot. Keep all comparison artifacts in the persistent workspace and explain the remaining visual differences.
evals.expected_output: A working adaptive implementation plus a runs-local iteration containing measured Figma and DOM hierarchy data and grouped expected, actual, and diff images.

evals.prompt: Pick a compact card-like component from a Figma file, reproduce it in the browser, and use visual diffing to refine its geometry. The component has translucent styling, so make the comparison background explicit.
evals.expected_output: A browser implementation and a 4x comparison run that uses the same explicit background for Figma compositing and browser capture.

evals.prompt: Recreate a small text-and-icon group from a Figma design and visually compare it in Storybook or an isolated browser fixture. Diagnose size mismatches before pixelmatch and do not hard-code screenshot constraints into the component.
evals.expected_output: An adaptive component, explicit measurement evidence, equal-sized captures, and a visual diagnosis that distinguishes typography raster differences from layout errors.
